_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'. Layout note: brev-cli/ (top-level) is a pristine mirror of the upstream NVIDIA agent files (see brev-cli/UPSTREAM.md) - a deliberate deviation from the flat-plugin rule, like visual-qa's serving/.
name: nvidia-brev
description: Run project workloads on NVIDIA Brev cloud GPU instances with a fully autonomous lifecycle: brev-setup installs the CLI and guides account registration/login; brev-run sizes, creates, provisions, uses, monitors, and ALWAYS tears down instances, with mandatory per-instance cost ledgering in ai/.memory/brev-costs.md. Carries a pristine mirror of the upstream brev-cli agent reference (brev-cli/).

notes: Requires the `brev` CLI and an NVIDIA Brev account (console.brev.nvidia.com). The brev-setup skill drives installation and login - it never asks for passwords/tokens in chat; login happens in the user's browser.
Record the Brev account/org used in the project's ai/.memory/credentials.md (gitignored). Never store credentials in the repo.
Create ai/.memory/brev-costs.md from the template in brev-run.skill.md on first use - every instance ever created gets a row there at teardown, including aborted attempts.

resources.prompt: Brev organization to bill instances to (shown by `brev org ls`)
